evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Lorena, we speak with a lot of customers everyday and some of their concerns are either, movers not arriving on time or damages to their items or any of this or concerns as well.
evidence_quotes.value_days: If your dates are flexible, we can actually save it to $12 per hour. If you wanted, I mean, $20 per hour if you want to do it on a Sunday. But if Saturday is like the best day then definitely we still have availability for that day as well in the afternoon.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Thank you so much. Lorena just let us know if you're ready to go ahead with the booking. Have a good day.

top_strength: Joanna used the customer's name throughout the call, asked the two-concerns question before probing, covered both packing and box count, and offered a clear value-day savings comparison with a dollar amount.
coaching_note: Step 7 ask was weak and lacked the rate-lock and no-deposit framing before asking for the business; also no final concerns check was performed at step 6, and the Two Promises were delivered without the permission lead-in and without closing the loop on both.
